service: Hyper3D Rodin (hyper3d.ai), Business plan, through the hyper3d MCP server
prompt: A slim, flat attache case in matte black clay lying flat on the ground and opened wide: the thin lid swings up almost upright, joined to the base along the back edge, and the front of the base faces the viewer with a chunky handle in the middle and two old-gold latches. The shallow inside is lined in warm gold clay. No light rays. Hand-sculpted matte modeling clay, stop-motion claymation style, chunky rounded forms. One single closed object, no base, no text, no logos.

files.model.fbx: Rodin's base_basic_pbr.fbx; its embedded diffuse map is the final one, and its normal, roughness and metallic maps are flat 1-pixel images (flat normal, roughness 0.85, not metallic), so the clay stays matte

credits: Rodin reports no cost per call; about 0.5 credit a generation (T81's measurement). T105's total is in Docs/tasks/T105.md.
note: glow.png masks the gold lining (fixtex.swift glow, hue 28-58); it also catches the two small gold latch plates. The god rays are an engine light, not in the model.
